tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs gsang gnyis la brten nas bum chog byed tshul bzhugs/

na mo badzra bhai ra wa ye/ 'jal dpal zhi khro dus kyi mthar/ /ngur smrig gar kyis rnam rol ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs btud nas/ /'jigs byed bum bskyed mdor bsdus bri/ /'dir 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la brten nas lho sgo'i cho ga byed mkhan mang du snang yang*/ bum bskyed mdzad pa'i srol ma dar 'dug pas/ de la bum bskyed cho ga'i gzhung bzhin byed pa byung na legs mod/ min kyang bum chog bsdus pa byed tshul la lha lnga tsam bskyed pa dang*/ lha bcu gsum mdor bsdus nas bskyed pa'i tshul gnyis las/ snga ma ni mkhas pa'i srol ltar bdag gis gzhan du bris zin la/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas nas brjod par bya ste/ bum pa mchod pa dang bcas sta gon byas nas mdun du stegs kyi khar bzhag ste/ hrīḥṣtsiḥs bsangs/ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tāpte tāpte ma hā tāpte swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nang gi shar dang mtshams bzhi dang*/ phyi'i mtshams bzhir sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan zung re re/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ nang gi shar du kṣe las 'khor lo kṣes mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar du ya las tho pa las mtshan pa/ nas/ nang gi shar lhor dzaḥlas 'khor lo dzaḥs mtshan pa/ nas/ phyi'i mtshams bzhir ṇa yo ni rā'i yi ge bzhi rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba phyag 'tshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi skur yongs rdzogs par gyur ba ni/

dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshes yab yum/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum/ zhes pa nas/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar du tho ba gshin rje gshed yab yum/ nas/ nang gi shar lhor tsa rtsi ka yab yum/ nas/ phyi'i mtshams bzhir mi'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bzhir gyur/ rgyas par 'dod na lha thams cad kyi skyed chog gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su kṣi/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥ ha bho nas ku ru swā hā/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥ ṣtīḥbi kṛ nas hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ muṅga ga ra dzaḥ nas khaṅga hoḥ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams sbyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskul du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis spros pa'i la lha mo tsa rtsika la sogs pas bum pa'i chus sbyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yaungs su gyur ba las gtso bo'i rtsa zhal yi dbu la mi bskyod pa zhes pa nas dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ spro na dkyus ltar bya'o/ /mchod pa bsangs sbyangs bskyed nas/ oṃ ya mānta ka sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta pra tītstsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ nang mchod kyang 'bul/ gnyis med thub mong ma yin zhes sogs sam/ yang na gzugs mchog ma'i mjug tu gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ zhes pa nas/ phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pa'am/ bsdu na gzugs mchog ma tsam gyis bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsams la/ sngags ci 'grub dang yi ge gsum lan nyer gcig gam bdun dang*/ khaṭga dhrig gis bsangs par 'dod na/ de nyid slar lan bdun sogs bzla/ mthar yig brgya lan gsum/ slar yang oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥha zhes sogs kyis mchod cing*/ nang mchod 'bul tshul rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na ya mānta ka sa pā ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ gis phul/ bstod pa sngar bzhin rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas nas/ bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'jigs gsang gnyis la brten nas bum chog byed tshul bzhugs/ -PAGE 194--PAGE 195--PAGE 193-
